title: Oppenheimer on the Aztec crash retrieval team

tellings.quote: there's a book by William Steinman called you know um UFO crash about the Aztec crash retrieval and they say Oppenheimer was part of the retrieval team

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, cites a book by William Steinman, UFO Crash at Aztec, about a craft said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948 and been recovered. Michels says the book claims Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the building of the atomic bomb, was part of the team that recovered it. If true, it would place one of America's top scientists at a recovered craft.
